global_gate: STOP: proven direct target metadata in candidate inputs and privileged action-generation modes. No new training performed.
scan_method: Every NPZ ZIP member list inspected; action/physics shapes and selected labels/weights/caps read for every episode. All field headers inspected per exact key-set schema; not a whole-array corruption audit. Every JSONL record parsed; all nested field paths enumerated. Media/weights/source snapshots inventoried separately.

raw_npz_families.identity_semantics: Fresh simulator episodes indexed by physical condition/reset seed; no persistent independently sampled cube identity. Condition hash is physical/intervention setting identifier.
raw_npz_families.physical_setting_label_correlation: Setting/condition IDs identify parameter values; do not use as predictor features. Splitting reset episodes alone reuses physical settings.
raw_npz_families.truth_storage: Episode scalar label__mass_kg, label__object_static_friction, label__object_dynamic_friction, plus explicit material/body metadata. All files read; scalar per-episode storage. Owning collectors set properties at reset, not during step.
raw_npz_families.existing_split: No train/test cube split stored in these raw episode fields or family path. Evaluation interventions/grids and reset seeds are not an independent-cube training split.

direct_leak_evidence.finding: Explicit supplied truth appears both as scalar input and weight coordinate42; policy actions were generated from true mass and friction. Excluding the truth columns alone does not remove privileged behavior policy.

Actual observations contain mass×gravity and friction. Supplied intervention vectors use true, fixed, or invertibly wrong values. Only fixed_both removes both true label coordinates from the action policy. Raw observation still contains truths in GPU traces.
Separate truth metadata nested under state; direct mass label if blanket flattening includes it. Original policy_observation42 excludes mass and friction.

causal_and_sampling_cautions: Do not confuse ideal sensed force/gap/motion responses with explicit labels: their physics dependence is the intended identification signal.
input__* alone is insufficient allowlisting for unknown-mass learning: input__reported_mass_kg is constant in fixed40g data, but truth in true retries.
Response/interval-force/pose-derived-velocity arrays describe action[t] to state[t+1]; use only after that transition, never as pre-action features for its next-state target.

sim__policy_observation forces43/44 are object-attributed pairwise sensor proxies; contact masks and ragged contacts also use object identity. Label metadata includes inertia/weight/COM/materials; excluded from unprivileged features.

Dense design changes at most two factors per condition along signed diagonals; many factors are nominal. It is not an IID fully crossed physics population. Physical-setting or condition groups must be separated if claiming unseen-object generalization.
Retry attempts are outcome-censored (stop at success), and adaptive methods depend on previous attempts; not independent matched episodes or fixed exposure counts.
No new training is authorized after proven leakage until user chooses a safe subset/feature and behavior-policy protocol.
path_semantics: All paths are relative to workspace_root unless explicitly absolute.

field_alignment.state: T+1 samples including reset, state[t] is before action[t].
field_alignment.transition: T samples, command[t] and its observed response ending at state[t+1].
field_alignment.physics: T*K samples, K=sim_hz/control_hz; samples occur after each physics substep.
field_alignment.label: Scalar/constant labels describe episode physical parameters or derived episode outcomes; never blanket-flatten labels into predictor inputs.
field_alignment.units: SI: kg, m, s, N, radians. Quaternions wxyz. Joint positions first7 rad, final2 m.
field_alignment.unknowns: No audit of real-robot sensor feasibility, noise or calibration. No independent measurements of true physical parameters; these are simulator labels/readbacks. This inventory is not a scientific split approval.

aggregate_only_evaluation_files.invalid_reason: Diagnostic discovered solver contact-history carryover on reset without reconfiguration. Superseded by fresh-scene matched evaluation; do not use these results for physics input benefit.
aggregate_only_evaluation_files.limitation: These outcome rows may exceed the serialized first-seed/mode step traces; do not count them as additional recoverable state-action trajectories.

published_pretrained_metadata_note: models/trajectory*.json and manifest.published_metadata describe external official demonstrations; no corresponding downloaded official training trajectory arrays are present here. Local evaluation JSONL traces are counted separately.
remaining_unknowns: Collection manifests preserve generator provenance, but this audit did not replay simulators or reexecute each historical frozen source snapshot.
Except explicit recorded invariance checks, scalar episode labels plus owning source establish constant-parameter episodes; no per-step physical-material readback arrays exist.
Whole-source-array corruption checks and numerical finite validation were not run; this is a full family/field inventory with every-file scalar/length coverage.
Realized grip caps are logged for NPZ episodes. Pretrained JSONL exports do not log a separate per-step motor force cap; their native controller setting must come from environment configuration.
Pretrained JSONL exports do not store true friction. No friction should be invented from mass or filename; historical task friction rules require source-specific reconstruction if used later.
